models.name: todo_list_users
models.description:
Unique record of every end-user registered within the Todo List service.

Serves as the single actor/identity table for business logic, authentication, and ownership of todos. Each user has a unique email address and securely hashed password for authentication. Only authenticated users may access or manipulate their own todos; system supports soft deletion and audit of all account events. All user data is distinct, unshareable, and not visible to others. This entity underpins all privacy and security guarantees for the application.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Uniquely identifies each user account.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for login. Enforced as case-insensitive unique index. Required for authentication and account recovery.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password string for user authentication. Never plain text. Computed using secure, industry-standard algorithms.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for when the user account was first created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last modification (e.g., password or profile changes).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion marker. If set, account is marked for removal and excluded from normal access.

models.name: todo_list_user_sessions
models.description:
Login session records supporting secure, auditable user authentication workflows.

Each session tracks one authenticated connection for a user with essential forensic information. Required fields include IP, connection URLs, and start/expiry times. Sessions provide complete audit context for all sensitive account actions and enable secure concurrent logins. Managed strictly as subsidiary data for the parent user; direct independent CRUD is not needed, but indexed for audit and investigation.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Uniquely identifies each authentication session.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_user_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign key to owning user. Links session to unique user account. {@link todo_list_users.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address used for this session. For audit and security tracing.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Full connection URL for originating request.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL captured at session start.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session termination or expiration timestamp. Nullable for active sessions.

models.name: todo_list_todos
models.description:
Business tasks (todos) that form the core of the Todo List Application.

Each record represents a user-owned todo, capturing an actionable task with ownership strictly enforced by foreign key reference to {@link todo_list_users}. All todos support required titles, optional descriptions, a boolean completion status, and an optional due date. Field length and data type constraints support robust validation and prevent invalid submission. 

Audit fields record creation and update times for history and sorting purposes. Todos cannot be shared, delegated, or accessed by other users—strict data isolation is enforced through both foreign key and business logic. Permanent deletion is supported, with no soft-deletion workflow required by business in the MVP. Efficient filtering by owner, creation date, and completion status is enabled by indexes. This table provides the sole persistent record of all business tasks for each authenticated user.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_user_id
foreignFields.description: Owner user for this todo task. Foreign key to {@link todo_list_users.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Required short textual title for the todo. Must be present and 1–100 characters in length; validated in application layer.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional longer plaintext description of the todo for additional context. May be null or up to 600 characters if present.

plainFields.name: completed
plainFields.description: Boolean indicating whether this todo task is complete. Defaults to false at creation; can be toggled by owner.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Optional ISO8601 date by which the todo is expected to be completed. Null if not set; must be current or future date if present.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp in UTC when the todo was created. Used for sorting, filtering, and audit history.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was most recently updated. Updated automatically on change.
